title: Correction Remediation Rollback Gates
principle: Every backend-owned source mutation must expose a protected preview, confirmation and rollback path before broader automation is trusted.
public_repo_rule: GitHub Pages may request rollback previews and show receipts. It never owns rollback mutation authority, stores raw content or starts paid routes.

backend_route.purpose: Preview and apply rollback for supported remediation execution receipts through backend-only rollback gates.

ui_contract.auto_preview: executeRemediationCommit automatically calls previewRemediationRollback when the backend returns an execution receipt

blocked_rollback.reason: Only applied memory execution receipts with captured before metadata can be rolled back until knowledge source mutation models exist.

scenarios.expected: A successful supported execution automatically requests a rollback preview.
Supported memory rollback can be applied only after rollback preview and confirmation.
Executions without captured before metadata render a blocked rollback preview.
Rollback receipts expose public-safe before/after metadata and result status.

next.label: Knowledge remediation source model
next.reason: Memory repairs now have execution and rollback gates. Knowledge repairs need a protected source/collection model before mutation can be safe.
